scope: A governed retrospective over the R6 -> R8 span of mission CNV-PIPD-LS-SP-20261015. It records what was investigated, what the loop learned about itself, what was actually changed in the process artifacts, and what must change with an owner and a gate. It is NOT an acceptance, an approval, a policy change or a promotion.
claim_ceiling: LOCAL / candidate-only; every item below is falsifiable by the evidence path it cites

self_research.question: Which of the nine external findings still hold against live state?
self_research.method: counterexample-first re-run of each finding's own check (GitHub tree/manifest set diffs, ACL read, mutation re-measurement, library scan)
self_research.result: 06 closed locally (maintainer authorisation executed, main b8ff8104); 01/02 narrowed to two identified unshipped cache paths; 03 root cause found (no deny ACE; Authenticated Users inherit Modify); 04 counterexamples closed on main (M04/M06/M16 REJECT); 05/07/08 confirmed owner/authority-gated; 09 measured and in treatment.

self_research.question: Does the guarded subject still equal what was published?
self_research.method: per-file git-blob sha1 comparison against the merged packet tree at b8ff8104 (300 files)

self_research.question: Are the R6 packet's declared and shipped sets equal?
self_research.method: tree API blob set vs PACKET_MANIFEST.json files[] set
self_research.result: NOT equal: 583 declared vs 581 shipped; the two extras are __pycache__ .pyc paths - the count mismatch has a single identified cause instead of being an unknown

self_research.question: Do the slimmed skill candidates actually preserve content?
self_research.method: six-check regression gate incl. reference-coverage (bytes present verbatim anywhere in the corpus)
self_research.result: AVR candidate needed repair (10 slice markers; 1 stale absorbed reference) then landed and verified lossless; HGK candidate is NOT landable (2 reference texts do not survive: lane-conformance-gate.md absent, step-verify-only-lane.md rewritten with the remainder absent)

self_research.question: Is there any OS-level protection on the guarded subject?
self_research.method: effective ACL read + deny-ACE mechanism proof on scratch
self_research.result: No deny ACE exists; the mechanism works and is reversible, but with one shared Windows identity it can only enforce immutability, not maker/checker separation

self_research.question: Does the hardening port cleanly onto main?
self_research.method: rebuild on dba4b19, run the suite and all 18 mutations
self_research.result: counterexamples closed on main (10/10 detected, M04/M06/M16 REJECT, 8 NOT_RUN re-judged) BUT the port introduces 2 main-divergence failures, one of which is an unhandled crash (derive_frozen_context, 'str' has no 'get') - new blocking findings, not fixed and not hidden

self_research.question: What do the control-plane planes actually bind to?
self_research.method: read the lane pool, the governed profile and the delegation config
self_research.result: lane pool rank 1 for PLAN and VERIFY is the same model (gpt-6.1-sol); EXECUTE is deepseek-v4.1-flash; the governed profile binds PLAN as declared; PLAN and VERIFY therefore share a model axis by owner design

self_learning.lesson: A checklist that only compares declared counts can pass while content is silently dropped. Losslessness must be tested by byte presence, not by file counts or sha tables.
self_learning.trigger: the HGK candidate passed my first harness version and failed only after the reference-coverage check was added
self_learning.fix: C6_reference_coverage added to the harness; both candidates re-judged; the previously 'PASS' verdict was withdrawn

self_learning.lesson: An expectation hardcoded at build time turns into a false red as soon as the subject evolves; the right response is to derive the expectation, never to delete the assertion.
self_learning.trigger: TF-10 in the R7 self-check harness
self_learning.fix: harness repaired to resolve expectations from HEAD, git inventory, committed manifest and runtime discovery, with the negative control retained and 7 regression tests

self_learning.lesson: A post-apply losslessness proof must be run against the PRE-image, not against the applied tree: comparing the applied tree with itself makes every absorbed reference look stale.
self_learning.trigger: my first post-apply run reported 6 false sha mismatches
self_learning.fix: re-ran with subject = live tree and live = WS_A/apply/preimage; PASS with 0 lost lines and 0 lost references

self_learning.lesson: When the lane cannot evidence which model arm served a turn, the products may still be verifiable - but the attribution claim must be dropped, not softened.
self_learning.trigger: dispatcher EXIT 3 / no nonce emitted for the EXECUTE arm on this round's writer lanes
self_learning.fix: recorded as an unproven attribution in the WS-A recheck and in the ledger; the finding stays open for the tooling owner

self_learning.lesson: A guard that blocks the agent's own write is a feature: the correct response is to ask the owner, then use the sanctioned authorization path - never to rephrase the payload to slip past it.
self_learning.trigger: two sub-agent receipts were refused by the pre-tool guard
self_learning.fix: asked the owner; the owner authorised the sanctioned, time-boxed path; receipts written afterwards with their provenance disclosed

self_learning.lesson: Publishing must state what it deliberately excluded, not only what it included; 'nothing missing' is not the same claim as 'nothing dropped silently'.
self_learning.trigger: the R6 manifest mismatch and cache files in a live skill tree
self_learning.fix: the R8 publication manifest now records excluded_scratch[] with a reason per path

self_learning.observation: A checker reproduced the counts correctly but inverted the cause; the orchestrator's own re-measurement caught it.
self_learning.rule: Re-measure a checker's causal attributions, not only its numbers - narrative clauses in a verdict are claims.

self_iteration.change: added C6 (reference coverage) and fixed stub classification so that marker-less short files are not mis-read as absorbed stubs
expectations derived at run time; negative controls and 7 regression tests retained
re-parameterised for a new prefix/branch and an explicit exclusion ledger in the manifest
verifier briefs now pin the checker's write root outside every subject; board cards carry instrument-readable evidence strings; the round plan records canonical side effects
the round's contracts (cap, loader parity, soft-warning-only reference threshold, guarded apply, rebase requirement, owner gates) are now expressible as a validated change proposal
added a clean-baseline worktree step (detached at the base commit) to the verification protocol before any porting claim is filed
self_iteration.status: applied this round when the disagreement surfaced

self_evolution.proposal: Give the checker a distinct OS identity or a scoped sandbox so that maker/checker separation is enforced rather than documented.
self_evolution.gate: owner authorisation for an identity/ACL change; no agent self-grant
self_evolution.why: with one shared identity the strongest available control is immutability of the subject

self_evolution.proposal: Make lane arm attribution a first-class receipt field and fail the receipt closed when no arm emits its nonce.
self_evolution.gate: tooling change under HGK admission; must not become a lane outage
self_evolution.why: products were verifiable while attribution was not; the claim ceiling should degrade automatically
self_evolution.evidence: tooling finding TF-06 (8 occurrences this mission)

self_evolution.proposal: Adapt the R7-0 hardening to main's newer contracts before it can ship: restore fail-open behaviour only where the frozen context is legitimately absent, and fix derive_frozen_context's handling of a string-typed field.
self_evolution.gate: new ChangeSet (R9-0) with its own admission, checker and mutation set
self_evolution.why: the port closes the counterexamples but introduces 2 main-divergence failures, one a crash path

self_evolution.proposal: Repair the HGK skill-slim candidate instead of applying it: restore the two lost reference texts, drop cache files from the apply set, then re-run the gate.
self_evolution.gate: guarded apply with pre-image and rollback, as used for the AVR skill
self_evolution.why: applying it as-is would delete instructional content

self_evolution.proposal: Issue the versioned R6 publication errata naming the two unshipped cache paths and the stale counts, without rewriting the merged packet.
self_evolution.why: it converts an unexplained count mismatch into a recorded, reproducible difference

self_evolution.proposal: Keep the >60-reference condition as a warning and treat the over-cap main files as a queue item, not a hard gate.
self_evolution.why: 2 main files exceed 100,000 bytes and one skill has 118 references; raising the cap or splitting mechanically without the losslessness gate would trade a warning for silent loss

self_evolution.proposal: Keep the residual SoD disclosure standing: PLAN and VERIFY are served by the same model family on this lane by owner decision, so independence rests on process, lane, receipt and write-root separation - and on the OS identity once SE-1 lands.
self_evolution.gate: owner decision; agents must not silently 'fix' the scheme
self_evolution.why: claiming model-axis independence would be false

falsifiers.SR-2: any file under the guarded subject whose git-blob sha1 differs from the merged packet tree
falsifiers.SR-4: a live reference whose bytes cannot be found in the applied corpus
falsifiers.SR-6: a mutation row on main that returns ACCEPT where REJECT is required, or a suite run without the two recorded failures
falsifiers.SE-1: an ordinary process (same identity) writing into the guarded subject and succeeding - which is exactly today's observed state

non_claims: not an acceptance, approval, Gate PASS, or production statement
no verdict is upgraded by this artifact
no authority is created: every SE item names an owner and a gate
the retrospective is authored by the orchestrator that ran the round; it is not an independent review of itself
